NovaX is built on these outstanding open-source projects — with thanks.
Full license texts are available at https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0 and other official sources.\nNovaX stands on the shoulders of giants — thank you, open-source community.

Kotlin 2.2.20 / Coroutines 1.10.2 / AndroidX (Core 1.17.0 · Lifecycle 2.9.4 · Activity Compose 1.11.0 · Navigation Compose 2.9.5) / Jetpack Compose (BOM 2026.09.00, incl. Material Icons) / DataStore 1.1.7 / Room 2.8.2 / Coil 3.3.0
Offline Chinese pinyin indexing and natural title sorting. Project: https://github.com/belerweb/pinyin4j
NovaX\'s playback foundation and file core are derived from the Nova Video Player open-source project — many thanks to the original project and its community.
android.media3 provides decoding, track selection, subtitle rendering and media sessions — the cornerstone of this app\'s playback core.

org.videolan.android:libvlc-all — RM/RMVB software decoding and transcoding/frame-extraction playback core, bundled with the app. The full license text and source availability are provided as required by LGPL 2.1. Project: https://code.videolan.org/videolan/vlc-android

FFmpeg (libavcodec/libavutil/swresample, n4.4.4 statically linked into libffmpegext.so) — AC3/E-AC3/DTS/TrueHD audio software decoding, built with an LGPL 2.1 configuration (no GPL components enabled). The full license text and source availability are provided as required by LGPL 2.1. Project: https://ffmpeg.org
com.hierynomus:smbj — SMB2/3 client protocol library providing connection reuse and offset reads for direct NAS reading and fast seeking.

com.hierynomus:sshj — SFTP client protocol library powering directory browsing and random-read playback for SFTP sources (reusing the SMB pipeline for reads). Project: https://github.com/hierynomus/sshj
net.i2p.crypto:eddsa — transitive dependency of sshj for the Ed25519 signature algorithm.
org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk18on — cryptographic foundation under sshj\'s transitive dependencies (SFTP handshake and key exchange). Project: https://www.bouncycastle.org

eu.agno3.jcifs:jcifs-ng — SMB client implementation used for share enumeration (an independent short connection behind the wizard\'s \"Get share list\"), bundled with the app. The full license text and source availability are provided as required by LGPL 2.1. Project: https://github.com/AgNO3/jcifs-ng
org.slf4j:slf4j-android — logging facade (dependency of the SMB stack). Project: https://www.slf4j.org
com.squareup.okhttp3 — HTTP client carrying WebDAV and network stream access. Project: https://github.com/square/okhttp
org.jupnp:org.jupnp.android — DLNA/UPnP device discovery and control. Project: https://github.com/jupnp/jupnp
org.eclipse.jetty — local streaming server for casting (transport/GENA layer under jUPnP). Project: https://github.com/jetty/jetty.project

dev.chrisbanes.haze (haze / haze-blur / haze-glass) — liquid-glass material rendering library (blur, edge refraction and highlights, used throughout the 2026-10 glass UI rework). Project: https://github.com/chrisbanes/haze

The modern Android development stack: language and coroutines, AndroidX foundation components (home/lifecycle/navigation), declarative UI and icons (material-icons-extended), key-value and relational persistence, image loading.
